messages:
mika: Quick sync \
ana: Need explicit launch gates for the Optimize advisor: batching, cache recommendations, quant recs, eval alerts.\
trent: Propose lightweight gates: p95 <= 120ms (short seq), >=12% unit-cost improvement on pilot, eval-regression <= 1%, successful canary with a pilot customer.\
kai: Eng asks: hardware validation (A100/H100/T4), fallback routing verified, cache eviction tests, and batching shouldn't push P99 >10% up.\
mika: ML acceptance: per-model quant profiles + calibration, quality delta <0.5% on primary metric, and token-level drift telemetry.\
ana: UX: Console opt-in toggle, migration guide, and customer comm templates for eval alerts.\
trent: Canary config example for ops: duration 72h, traffic 5%, rollback if eval_regression >1% or error_rate +0.5%.\
ops-bot: deployment-bot: Canary job queued for branch optimize-advisor/pilot-2026-03.\
mika: I'll draft a short PR with checklist + canary config + doc skeleton. Target: ship by sprint end (~3 weeks). Any blockers?\
kai: Need eng-infra signoff and 48h to provision test infra.\
ana: I'll confirm two pilot customers for the canary today.\
mika: Thanks all, scheduling a 30m sync Fri to finalize owners :thumbsup:
